text_block_list.text:
While searching for Silence Suzuka,
who hadn't shown up for training—

...I spotted Silence Suzuka turning to the left
while groaning softly under her breath.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I have an English vocab test tomorrow.
I always get scolded for low scores, so..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "I was trying to figure out how I could study for tests while running, but—"
choice_data_list: ...It's already time for training, you know?
...It's already time for training, you know?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh?
Is it that time already...?

...To a surprised-looking Silence Suzuka,
I told her to prioritize studying today.
